changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Post-Incident Reviewer to Improvement Follow-Through Coordinator route, review/action evidence and executable completion checks.
Scopes setup to small engineering teams and defaults to one workflow unless access or lifecycle boundaries require a split.
Defaults human approvals to durable asynchronous review: preparation ends pending review and a later action validates the recorded decision and current state.
Adds an explicit inspect-first discovery step, focused customer questions, recorded user direction, and a clear boundary that installation is not approval.

title: Post-Incident Review and Actions
description: Reconstruct one stabilized incident from frozen sources, propose a blameless review, then track accepted improvements to independently verified completion.
setup_prompt: Treat Post-Incident Review and Actions as a proposal. Inspect my stable incident and recovery evidence, impact rule, review owner, action and publication policy, issue/verification sources, and existing Crews. Propose reuse or creation of Post-Incident Reviewer and Improvement Follow-Through Coordinator, exact artifact checks and a bounded manual case in Builder chat. Selection creates no Crew, issue, publication, reminder or schedule.

setup_inputs.label: Stable incident, exact service/environment and frozen source revision
Impact denominator, window, event and milestone rules
Blameless review scope, evidence/privacy policy and approval owner
Action owner, due date, acceptance and independent verification policy
Authorized incident, telemetry, issue and verification sources
Optional approved publication and notification destinations

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Recurring causes, systemic risk, and investment priorities
Whether follow-up work reduces future impact
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
